Functions bought with the car stay included for the first owner

Proposal
1, implement. 47 complaint rows about connected upgrades, all usability: functions such as automatic high beam and live traffic switch off after three months; the catalogue lists Digital Premium as time-limited (480 EUR option). Owners feel misled and say they will change brand.
Horizon
H1. Offer and licensing decision; no hardware change.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-F70-EU-ID-03 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Functions that are fitted and shown at handover (high-beam assistant, traffic information, 3D maps, media apps) shall stay active for the first owner without a subscription, and any time-limited content shall be stated clearly at the point of sale.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

EUHardware-enabled safety and lighting functions behind a subscriptionNoneOffer checkassumption
